title: JusticeNetBD: Context-Aware AI to Enhance Legal Information Access for Bangladeshi Women via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
content: Women in Bangladesh often face barriers in accessing justice due to gender-based violence, workplace harassment, and limited awareness of legal protections. Despite existing laws, complex language and fragmented resources hinder women from seeking redress. Hence, many women do not realize a specific law exists for the harassment they faced, so they just feel uncomfortable, not knowing it was actually illegal. This paper proposes JusticeNetBD, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based legal assistant designed to provide accurate, context-aware, and accessible legal guidance tailored for Bangladeshi women. While the current focus is women’s legal rights, the framework is designed for gradual expansion to all Bangladeshi law domains. The system integrates a curated corpus of national laws (e.g., Dowry Prohibition Act 2018, Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000) and institutional support data, leveraging the Meta’s Llama 3 AI (8B version) to generate grounded responses. Evaluated against benchmarks like ChatGPT-4o, Gemini Flash 2.5, and DeepSeek-V3, JusticeNetBD achieves superior retrieval performance (Recall@k = 0.90, MRR = 0.90) and answer quality (ROUGE-L = 0.463, BERTScore F1 = 0.896), significantly outperforming closed-book models. By mitigating hallucination and enhancing traceability to legal texts, the system offers a scalable, culturally sensitive solution to bridge the justice gap for women in low-resource settings. The beta version of the application is hosted via Streamlit. Application access link and reproducibility guidelines are available in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/SakibHasanSimanto/JusticeNetBD.
